items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Billie Franklin in the context of Earl Hines' band; Interviewee does not mention Billie Franklin or claim a personal connection.

ctx.x: And of course, Earl was on every night at midnight from the Grand Terrace in those days, in the thirties. He's come on there with "Deep Forest," his theme song. Reginald Forsythe wrote that. Reginald Forsythe, he's a black man.

So we were talking about Chicago and the Grand Terrace, and that was when Earl Hines was in the Grand Terrace with that great band he had with Billie Franklin and all those guys, Cecil Erwin and Quinn Wilson. when I had
No, he Quinn was there. And George Dixon, Walter Fuller on drums. (Ed. note- Fuller on trumpet)
